outline: Reference solution outline for Customer Support Portal. Build the required workflows with standalone Angular components, a clear state owner, focused services and accessible templates. Use a backend for persistent data, prices, inventory, authentication and authorization. Verify the required journeys with the configured test runner and document actual evidence.
key_decisions: Keep page composition, domain state, API adapters and reusable controls separated.
Represent loading, empty, success and error states distinctly.
Do not claim backend authorization from route guards or hidden controls.
Pin versions and record local build/test results.
verification_notes: This file is a protected outline, not a full drop-in repository or evidence of a passing build. Reviewer approval is required before publication.
